summary: Obfuscated Alibaba Cloud IMDS credential probe on startup in Markdown MCP package
details: Package is advertised as a Markdown documentation MCP server but at startup executes an undocumented Alibaba Cloud ECS instance-metadata (IMDS) probe. The destination IP (100.100.100.200), the IMDSv2 token path (/latest/api/token), the hostname metadata path (/latest/meta-data/hostname), the HTTP method (PUT), and the X-aliyun-ecs-metadata-token-ttl-seconds header are all reconstructed at runtime from a base64-encoded literal and char-code arrays in index.js rather than appearing as plain strings. The code PUTs to the IMDS token endpoint, GETs the hostname metadata, and writes the response body including the IMDS session token to output/meta_field_dump.txt in the working directory. On an Alibaba Cloud host the staged token can be used to retrieve role credentials for the instance's attached IAM role. Markdown TOC/stats/table tooling has no legitimate reason to contact a cloud metadata service, and the runtime reconstruction of every network identifier is a deliberate concealment pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
